title: ranunculus chaerophyllos subsp. millefoliatus
intro: Ranunculus chaerophyllos subsp. millefoliatus, commonly known as Alpine Buttercup, is a plant species in the Ranunculaceae family that is native to mountainous regions in Europe. Alpine Buttercup is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems and skin conditions, due to its health benefits in reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to stimulate digestion and relieve symptoms of allergies. The bioactive constituents of Alpine Buttercup include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
